results.original_title: Lena Situations : la femme la plus influente de France
results.overview: French documentary on the rising social media personality.

results.title: Wet Feathers
results.overview: After developing a phobia of pigeons, the eccentric Brett Trueman escapes to the underground town of Coober Pedy where he recounts experiences from his life.

results.title: Kashpirovsky. Under the Spell
results.overview: The film tells the remarkable story of Dr Anatoly Kashpirovsky, who, at the height of his career, claimed to anaesthetise three women remotely for major surgery through the sheer force of his persuasion. His televised healing séances, broadcast across the Soviet bloc, broke viewing records, reaching hundreds of millions of people. Loved by his followers and despised by his enemies, Kashpirovsky became an unlikely symbol of a world undergoing radical political transformation.

results.title: Caught in the Act
results.overview: A reality TV finale is plagued by scandal and a heinous murder! Now that's good television!

results.title: Birita
results.overview: In the Faroe Islands, a family of theatre people are working on staging ‘King Lear’ with the mother in the lead role – a beloved actress who suffers from Alzheimer’s.

results.title: The Brave Swing
results.overview: These days, Cheng-Cheng seems different. He doesn’t play baseball anymore and stays away from the field. It feels like he has something he can’t tell anyone. His mom tries to help but doesn’t know why. The fear and confusion come from one of the adults he trusts the most. One evening, Cheng-Cheng stands by the field, holding his bat, wondering—should he swing, or not?

results.title: A Murder Between Friends
results.overview: A legendary TV star solves a murder mystery at her country estate.

results.title: My Big Fat Gay Wedding
results.overview: After an exhausting weekend as a bridesmaid, Alex & her partner unexpectedly decide to plan their nuptials! Not one second later, all chaos breaks loose because everyone in Alex’s life has an opinion on hashtags to wedding parties to when to start trying for kids. Overwhelmed & hungry, Alex must navigate the absurdity of wedding planning to celebrate their love in their own way.

results.title: Dagnabbit!
results.overview: A homeowner. A crawlspace. An unwanted guest.

results.title: Wyatt Earp 2
results.overview: Wyatt Earp returns to Dead River, Texas to trap Sheriff John Behan. He then learns about the Cowboys Gang planning an ambush against him, his brothers, and Doc Holliday in Tombstone.

results.title: Fátima - A Filipe La Féria Opera Rock
results.original_title: Fátima - Ópera Rock de Filipe La Féria
results.overview: Fátima - Ópera-Rock is not just a show; it is a profound reflection on Portugal, its history, and the cultural, spiritual, and human dimensions that project our country onto the world stage, touching people from every continent and religion.  Inspired by the events of 1917 in Cova da Iria, where three children were at the center of a phenomenon that resonated universally, Filipe La Féria created a script and musical score that will remain in the memory of Portuguese theater.

results.title: Fontaines D.C.: Radio 1 at Reading and Leeds Festival 2026
results.original_title: Fontaines D.C.: Radio 1 at Reading and Leeds Festival 2026
results.overview: Stepping out as the second of the Friday night headliners at Reading Festival 2026 are the BRIT award-winning Irish-five piece Fontaines D.C. Hailing from Dublin, the band have built a dedicated, global fanbase through their distinctive, visceral sound and powerful live performances. Following the success of their critically acclaimed third album Romance, which saw the band enter a bold new era, Fontaines D.C. have firmly established themselves as one of the most exciting bands in the world. Marking a major return with their only UK festival appearance this year, this highly anticipated set is not to be missed.

results.title: Some Kind of Refuge
results.overview: On the shifting edge of the Mississippi River in New Orleans, the spirit of a fading outsider community endures through its two oldest residents.

results.title: De tal palo
results.overview: A retired grandfather, Manuel, gains legal custody of his 9 year old granddaughter, Irene, following an incident that leaves her mother in the hospital. Manuel must navigate guardianship and old age as his health starts deteriorating, making tough decisions along the way.

results.title: The Taste of Tea
results.overview: A Japanese boy returns to his late father’s hometown in Taiwan, where tea becomes the bridge between memory, grief, and newfound family.

results.title: Steaming Old Buddies
results.overview: Two middle-aged men, one of them Moroccan-Dutch, sit in a misty sauna and discuss the state of their lives. Their friendly banter begins in a typically defensive male style: racist, homophobic and sexist jokes, complaints about other people. Slowly, the Dutch man’s defences crumble as we learn about the emotional ruin of his life. Can he reach out to his children, his ex-wife, even his soon-to-depart best friend?

results.title: The Gorals
results.overview: With 200 days left before college entrance exams, In-hye, who cares for the school's animal pen, spends her time lecturing a duck instead of studying. Seo-hee, punished for carrying a knife, joins her, and they discover an abandoned meadow where they lose the duck, Hee-seon. Meanwhile, teacher Kim Ah-tae forms a college interview prep group for four neglected students. On interview day, In-hye and Seo-hee ditch school to find Hee-seon, camping in the meadow and gradually learning to survive in the wild.

results.title: Giudecca
results.overview: Set inside a progressive women's prison on Venice's Giudecca island, an art workshop becomes a space for four inmates—Jenni, Rachida, Patrizia, and Giulia—to paint their self-portraits and share their pasts. Through stories of violence, guilt, survival, and broken bonds, the documentary explores how forced confinement ultimately sparks a profound process of self-reflection and personal awareness.
